indices.name: GIFT NIFTY
indices.note: At 6:30 AM IST, about 90 points above Nifty's Thursday close of 25,884.50 — within the usual futures premium, pointing to a flat to mildly positive open; GIFT Nifty itself was −0.08% (giftnifty.org; Kotak Neo 25,986.5 at 5:52 AM)

why.t: GIFT Nifty at 25,975 at 6:30 AM IST, about 90 points above Nifty's 25,884.50 close — inside the usual 85–105 point premium (PTI via HDFC Sky), so a flat to mildly positive start is signalled (giftnifty.org, HDFC Sky).
FIIs bought ₹5,843 cr in cash on Thursday, an 18th straight session of buying (AIR News, Business Upturn); DIIs also bought ₹5,631 cr (NiftyTrader).
Brent settled 2.1% higher at $96.57 on Thursday — a risk for oil-sensitive stocks and the rupee (Peter Lewis briefing; ABC $96.53).
KOSPI +0.55% and Nikkei −0.02% in early Friday trade; Kosdaq jumped 4.17% (JBizNews). Wall Street was shut Thursday and has a half-day Friday.
The rupee closed 24 paise weaker at 92.44 per dollar on Thursday (provisional; PTI via HDFC Sky).
Mahanadi Coalfields lists on NSE/BSE today; issue price ₹136, OFS subscribed 1.52 times (ipoguru).
